messages:
jess-support: FYI customer 'quantum-apps' reports sudden spike in latency + 429s on Dedicated since ~09:20 UTC. They say requests are landing in us-west-coldpool-1 instead of their gold-dedicated pool. Attaching a short repro below.
quantum-apps: Hi, yes — started ~09:18. Previously stable. Example curl: `curl -H "x-tenant: quantum-apps" -H "x-tier: Gold" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` -> 429 or 200 with 6–12s tail latency. :frowning:
jess-support: Thanks. @ryan-oncall can you pick this up? We've already checked token limits and quota for their org — not exhausted. No active maintenance.
ryan-oncall: On it. Quick checks: routing table shows our control-plane returned pool `us-west-coldpool-1` for that tenant at 09:19:42. Looking at incoming headers from their request trace — I see `x-tier: ["gold"]` surprised to see it as an array.
nana-sre: tagging in case this is autoscaler/noisy neighbor — ANA is investigating kvcache pressure and GPU hot spots.
nana-sre: checked metrics — no autoscale events or OOMs. Coldpool has lower concurrency cap which explains latency. CPU/GPU utilization on gold-dedicated looks normal.
mike-controlplane: I pulled control-plane logs for 09:15–09:25. There's a recent change to the header parser (PR #987) that normalizes multi-value headers differently. It looks like `x-tier` array values are being coerced to lowercase and wrapped, while routing policy expects case-insensitive equality but a single-string header. The policy matcher failed to match the tenant->gold rule and fell through to default pool.
mike-controlplane: snippet from policy eval log: `eval(policy=tenant->tier) got operand "["gold"]" vs rule "Gold" -> no match`
lucy-csm: Customer impacted; they have production traffic on Dedicated. We should offer credits and a mitigation asap.
ryan-oncall: Repro locally with their header: `httpie GET api.redwood.ai/v1/generate x-tenant:quantum-apps x-tier:'["gold"]'` reproduces the fallthrough.
jess-support: Can we short-circuit with a tenant override mapping while you patch?
mike-controlplane: Yes. Temporary mitigation: create a policy entry matching `tenant=quantum-apps` -> `pool=gold-dedicated-1`. I can add via control plane admin API.
mike-controlplane: Running: ```
POST /admin/v1/tenant-overrides
{
  "tenant": "quantum-apps",
  "pool": "gold-dedicated-1",
  "reason": "emergency routing override due to header parser regression"
}
```
deploy-bot: deploy started: control-plane hotfix v2026.3.1 -> target staging then canary prod
ryan-oncall: After override, customer reports 200s and latency back to normal for a subset of requests. We'll keep override for traffic while patch lands.
amna-sre: Note: even after routing to gold pool some request samples still show elongated tail latencies (1–2 slow tokens) — looks like transient cache cold starts after reroute. Observability team alerted.
mike-controlplane: Root cause = header normalization in PR #987 changed how comma/array headers are serialized; policy matcher used strict string compare when it should normalize lists. I'll revert that line and add list-aware equality. I'll push hotfix to prod canary now.
jess-support: Please add a regression test capturing both `x-tier: Gold` and `x-tier: ["Gold"]` forms.
mike-controlplane: Yep. Adding tests + will add a guard in matcher to attempt JSON parse for bracketed values. Patch ready, canary rollout in 5m.
quantum-apps: Thanks. Any ETA on permanent fix? Also mention billing — we saw retries and extra tokens.
lucy-csm: We'll offer a credit for the error window (09:18–09:40) and follow up with invoice adjustment. I'll draft language and get approval.
ryan-oncall: Canary looks good, control-plane v2026.3.1 promoted to prod at 09:42. Observability shows routing matches restored to gold-dedicated for tenant traces.
nana-sre: Marking incident: noisy-neighbor ruled out. No autoscale misbehavior. Added note: routing fallthrough led to capacity mismatch -> throttling.
mike-controlplane: Post-incident actions: 1) revert risky header serialization change 2) add list-aware matcher + tests 3) expand monitoring for unexpected header formats 4) run canary that includes tenants with dedicated pools.
jess-support: I'll send customer a summary and credit offer. Keep thread updated if any regressions. :thumbsup:
quantum-apps: Confirming traffic normal now. Appreciate quick response and the override.
lucy-csm: Follow-up: creating support ticket with credit terms, cc billing.
ryan-oncall: Closing immediate incident, leaving postmortem task for next week. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
